title: Implement staged544 rank-five residual with reversible dirty scratch
body:
The actual helper 277 rank-five residual in both pinned [PR3945](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3945) providers can be implemented on a finite Gaussian lattice using **one arbitrary dirty workspace word instead of one clean word**, with every borrowed bit restored. This contribution pairs reversible numerical lifting with finite-state circuit synthesis and explicitly prices the tradeoff. It closes a bounded implementation obligation left open by [PR3994](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3994); it does not substitute a new provider or claim a new kappa.

The comparison is an explicitly constructed clean-accumulator baseline, not an undocumented predecessor implementation. Each C pair changes from 14 to 18 real-word arithmetic operations while removing the zero-initialization requirement for b+1 scratch bits. Both compute the same rounded map. Complete serialized L/R monomial routing is included. Per512-coordinate spectator lane:1280 pairs,23040 arithmetic operations,3792 real swaps,2304 negations, and one reusable dirty word. The construction emits literal X/CNOT/Toffoli circuits, with no additional workspace; the classical borrowed-bit decomposition is credited to Barenco et al., Lemma7.2. At b=32 the full macro costs 442109184 Toffolis, plus 5482752 X and 1031936 CNOT, versus 380425984 Toffolis plus the separately reported gates for the clean comparison. This is a clean-space improvement at an explicit time cost, not a speedup.

For f spectator lanes the completed error is at most 80sqrt(f) grid units under the explicit no-data-wrap condition. Scratch overflow is allowed and handled exactly. The bound maps to [PR #3994](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3994)'s aggregate logical-cut allowance with p>=beta+32+ceil(log2sqrt(f)); b=p+4 suffices for the stated signed range. No selected stock coefficient is inferred.

The package also finds the decisive substitution limit: on this actual source-bound macro, a dirty helper h=s=e0 gives Q(h+s)-Q(h)-Q(s) nonzero at 24 coordinates. Local exact inversion therefore does not preserve the provider's linear compensation proof after intervening arithmetic. Whole-word nonlinear recovery, actual recursive-child tariff/owner admission, tensor dimension, stock/tape and all-size obligations remain open. The paid rank-five child is not silently repriced as the scalar circuit above.

Validation: source/recipe authentication; both actual provider bindings; credited canonical-frame oracle on 512 basis columns;279552 modular half-sum cases;67584 pair states;17408 literal bit half-sum cases;2048 bit-pair states;10912 dirty-ladder states;2112 complete elementary-circuit states; actual full-macro forward/inverse/error checks; source corruption, parity, sign-extension, phase and missing-uncompute controls. Normal and optimized repository-registered replay pass. Read-only Git-free replay, committed-byte/history and official export results are recorded in the publication handoff. A separate agent independently compiled the elementary pair implementation; root performed a bounded proof/code review. No independent human or proof-kernel review is claimed.

Only `research/staged544-reversible-lattice-macro/` is added. Canonical main 20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90 and priority revision 6 remain unchanged. Root shell fetch encountered DNS failure; the GitHub connector confirmed canonical main and the exact existing object was used. Overlap:702 complete open-PR bodies at 08:39:35UTC and 718 at 09:04; Discussion coverage partial. No exhaustive novelty claim. [PR #3881](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3881)'s numerical residue lane was inspected and concerns a different producer/consumer.

Credit Dugongue, dataisfire, Jeremy Kothe, Sagar Thakrar, roger-sato, Arham Tahir, DreamingOfClouds, chafreaky, Cinna Davis, Barenco et al., and the complete retained native/owner/outer lineage. Exact predecessor notices are preserved. Chris R / Clear1nsight with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance across a coordinated agent team.

Open next question: bind one actual helper lifetime and caller allowance to this circuit and its nonlinear witness before optimizing or attempting full-provider adoption. No merges, selected-frontier changes or other packages are included.

Frozen publication checks: scientific commit `527c80c4e20d699abf6c089d825bb9be01288f94`, one canonical-parent commit,26 files. Registered normal/optimized replay passed; final read-only Git-free replay of all 26 exact package files passed in8.703s with unchanged bytes. Committed-byte/source-history checks and official committed-export integrity pass. Hosted CI pending at publication. Scope changed from `selected-stock-envelope` under the explicit staged544 assignment; no selected m73 stock claim.
